stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The inexpensive solar lamp was revolutionary for the remote community.
items.sentenceZh: 这种低成本太阳能灯为偏远社区带来了革命性的改变。
items.scene: At dusk in a remote community, an adult technician demonstrates one compact solar lamp illuminating a shared study table, while an old smoky fuel lamp sits unused in the background. Several adults see the dramatic practical improvement with complete hopeful faces and natural hands. Focus on transformative innovation, not politics. No flags, slogans, brand marks, readable controls, text or logos.
items.altText: 低成本太阳能灯照亮偏远社区的学习桌，带来巨大改变。

items.meaningZh: 冒险故事；浪漫史；传奇文学
items.sentenceEn: A quiet romance grew between the two gardeners.
items.sentenceZh: 两位园丁之间慢慢萌生了一段安静的恋情。
items.scene: Two unrelated adult gardeners pause together in a greenhouse after work, exchanging a small potted flower and warm eye contact while sharing a shy smile. Their complete faces, natural hands and respectful distance suggest a developing romance rather than a business exchange. No wedding imagery, sexualization, hearts, written notes, text or logos.
items.altText: 两位成年园丁在温室里交换小花盆，含蓄地流露爱意。

items.sentenceEn: The repair shop keeps its hardware sorted in small drawers.
items.sentenceZh: 维修店把五金零件分类放在小抽屉里。
items.scene: Inside a contemporary Chinese neighborhood repair shop, an adult owner sorts tangible hardware such as hinges, screws, nuts, bolts and metal brackets into rows of small open wooden drawers while holding a matching part for comparison. Complete focused face and natural hands. No computer hardware ambiguity, readable drawer labels, Chinese characters, brand packaging, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国社区维修店店主把螺丝、合页和金属零件分类收纳。

items.sentenceEn: The artisan filled the pillow until it felt soft and supportive.
items.sentenceZh: 工匠把枕头填充得柔软而有支撑力。
items.scene: In a modern Chinese textile workshop, an adult artisan fills one rectangular cloth pillow with clean buckwheat hulls, then gently presses its finished shape beside a removable fabric cover. The soft cushion, seam and filling are clearly visible. Complete face and natural hands. Decorative fabric has simple botanical motifs without calligraphy. No bedding brands, labels, text or logos.
items.altText: 纺织工匠把荞麦壳装进布枕头并检查柔软度。

items.sentenceEn: The hiking kit contains everything needed for a safe day outdoors.
items.sentenceZh: 这套徒步装备包含安全户外活动所需的一切。
items.scene: An open compact hiking kit is neatly arranged on a cabin table with a small first-aid pouch, flashlight, compass, water bottle, rain layer and repair cord, while an adult hiker checks each item before packing. Complete focused face and natural hands. Make the coordinated set of equipment unmistakable. No medicine names, compass letters, checklist writing, brand marks, text or logos.
items.altText: 徒步者检查打开的成套户外工具和应急用品。

items.sentenceEn: A continent is much larger than the islands around it.
items.sentenceZh: 大陆比周围的岛屿大得多。
items.scene: A curved globe-like view centers on one vast continuous green-brown landmass bordered by ocean, with several tiny nearby islands providing unmistakable scale contrast. Mountains, rivers and varied climates stretch across the huge continent. Human-free educational landscape. No political borders, country shapes emphasized, map labels, compass letters, text or logos.
items.altText: 辽阔的大陆跨越多种地形，旁边分布着几个小岛。

items.sentenceEn: A young seal rested on the sun-warmed rocks.
items.sentenceZh: 一只小海豹在晒暖的岩石上休息。
items.scene: One healthy young seal rests on a sun-warmed coastal rock just above calm water, with rounded flippers, whiskers and spotted wet fur clearly visible. A few seabirds remain distant and the shoreline feels peaceful. Human-free wildlife scene, natural anatomy and respectful observation. No captivity, touching, feeding, injury, text or logos.
items.altText: 一只健康的小海豹趴在海边晒暖的岩石上休息。

items.sentenceEn: The bulb lit when the circuit was complete.
items.sentenceZh: 电路接通后，灯泡亮了。
items.scene: On a clean workbench, an adult maker connects the final safe low-voltage wire between a battery pack, switch and small glowing bulb, forming one visibly continuous closed circuit. Components and wire path are easy to follow, and the lit bulb shows the result. Complete focused face and natural hands kept away from exposed mains power. No sparks, diagrams, symbols, labels, text or logos.
items.altText: 制作者接上最后一根导线，完整电路让小灯泡亮起。

items.sentenceEn: The referee's ruling awarded the point to the blue player.
items.sentenceZh: 裁判的裁决把这一分判给了蓝衣选手。
items.scene: During a friendly indoor badminton match, an adult referee makes a calm ruling by indicating the precise spot where the shuttlecock landed inside the boundary line, while two adult players pause and accept the decision. Complete neutral faces and natural hands. Focus on fair judgment, not conflict. No scoreboards, team names, hand signals resembling politics, written rules, text or logos.
items.altText: 羽毛球裁判指向落在线内的球，作出公平裁决。

items.sentenceEn: A shortage of chains left several bicycles unfinished.
items.sentenceZh: 链条短缺导致几辆自行车无法完工。
items.scene: In a bicycle workshop, several nearly completed bicycles wait in a neat row without chains while one adult mechanic holds the final remaining chain beside an otherwise empty parts bin. Complete concerned but composed face and natural hands. The missing repeated component makes shortage visually clear. No labor distress, inventory labels, order forms, text or logos.
items.altText: 自行车车间只剩一根链条，多辆车因零件短缺尚未完成。

items.sentenceEn: The village harvests its finest tea annually in early spring.
items.sentenceZh: 村里每年早春采收最好的茶叶。
items.scene: On terraced tea hills in China during early spring, adult growers carry out the annual first harvest, carefully picking fresh buds into woven baskets as the same seasonal trees blossom around a longstanding stone path. Complete faces and natural hands. The established communal ritual and spring renewal suggest a yearly event. No romanticized costumes, banners, characters, labels, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国茶农在早春进行一年一度的鲜嫩茶芽采收。

items.sentenceEn: Lately, it has rained almost every afternoon.
items.sentenceZh: 最近几乎每天下午都在下雨。
items.scene: A home entryway shows the accumulated signs of repeated recent rain: several damp umbrellas drying, wet shoes on a tray, fresh puddles outside and heavy clouds returning over the street while an adult hangs another raincoat. Complete mildly weary face and natural hands. The repeated wet items imply lately, not a single shower. No calendars, forecasts, labels, text or logos.
items.altText: 门口堆着多把湿雨伞和雨鞋，显示最近下午经常下雨。

items.sentenceEn: The technician used the machine to scan the patient's knee.
items.sentenceZh: 技术人员用机器扫描患者的膝盖。
items.scene: In a clean contemporary Chinese clinic, an adult imaging technician positions an adult patient's knee inside a compact open medical scanner while observing from beside the machine. Both remain calm, fully clothed and dignified; complete faces and natural hands are visible. The focused machine ring makes scanning clear. No diagnosis imagery, radiation symbols, readable screens, hospital names, characters, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国现代诊所里，技术人员用开放式设备扫描患者膝盖。

items.meaningZh: 愚人；受骗者；奶油拌水果
items.sentenceEn: She folded raspberries into cream to make a fruit fool.
items.sentenceZh: 她把覆盆子拌入奶油，制作水果奶油甜品。
items.scene: At a bright kitchen counter, an adult cook gently folds crushed raspberries into whipped cream, creating visible red-and-white swirls before spooning the mixture into clear dessert glasses. A bowl of whole berries establishes the fruit. Complete cheerful face and natural hands. Make the British fruit fool dessert unmistakable without depicting a foolish person. No recipe writing, packaging, text or logos.
items.altText: 厨师把覆盆子拌进奶油，制作红白相间的水果奶油甜品。

items.styleFamily: tense but constructive studio collage illustration
items.sentenceEn: The team finished the model just before the deadline.
items.sentenceZh: 团队刚好在截止时间前完成了模型。
items.scene: In a design studio, three adults place the final piece onto a finished architectural model while a large analog wall clock with no numerals nears the top and an hourglass has only a little sand remaining. Relief replaces concentration on their complete faces; natural hands coordinate the last action. No panic, all-night exhaustion, written schedule, dates, text or logos.
items.altText: 设计团队在时钟到点前装上最后部件，及时完成模型。

items.sentenceEn: The spare tire is stored at the rear of the vehicle.
items.sentenceZh: 备用轮胎存放在车辆后部。
items.scene: A parked utility vehicle is shown from a clear rear three-quarter angle with its back hatch open, revealing one spare tire secured in the cargo area's rear compartment. An adult owner points to the tire while standing safely beside the vehicle. Complete face and natural hands. No front-view ambiguity, license plate text, brand marks, labels or logos.
items.altText: 车辆后舱打开，备用轮胎固定存放在汽车后部。

items.sentenceEn: Careful processing turns fresh tea leaves into dried tea.
items.sentenceZh: 细致加工把鲜茶叶变成干茶。
items.scene: Inside a clean contemporary Chinese tea workshop, adult workers guide fresh green leaves through a visible sequence of withering trays, rolling drums and drying baskets, ending with finished dark curled tea leaves in the foreground. Complete focused faces and natural hands, safe equipment and clear transformation. No factory brand, labels, characters, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国茶叶工坊通过萎凋、揉制和干燥步骤加工鲜叶。

items.sentenceEn: The ranch raises cattle across a broad grassland.
items.sentenceZh: 这座牧场在广阔草原上饲养牛群。
items.scene: A broad working ranch stretches across open grassland with a healthy herd of cattle grazing behind sturdy fences, a barn and water trough nearby. An adult rancher on horseback calmly checks the fence from a safe distance, with complete face and natural hands. Respectful animal care, no branding irons, lassos in use, rodeo spectacle, text or logos.
items.altText: 广阔牧场里牛群在围栏内吃草，牧场主巡查设施。

items.sentenceEn: The coastal village faces the sea on three sides.
items.sentenceZh: 这座沿海村庄三面临海。
items.scene: A high but safe viewpoint reveals a contemporary Chinese coastal village on a narrow green peninsula, with tiled homes, a sheltered fishing harbor, rocky shoreline and open sea visibly surrounding three sides. A few adult residents repair nets behind a railing in the foreground. Complete faces and natural hands. No tourism slogans, boat names, characters, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国沿海村庄坐落在三面环海的绿色半岛上。

items.sentenceEn: The engineers agreed to undertake the bridge repair.
items.sentenceZh: 工程师们同意承担桥梁维修任务。
items.scene: At the safe edge of a small damaged pedestrian bridge, three adult engineers collectively begin a repair project by inspecting the cracked railing, opening a toolbox and carrying replacement timber into position. Their complete determined faces, natural hands and coordinated first steps show they have undertaken the responsibility. No catastrophic collapse, paperwork, contracts, text or logos.
items.altText: 工程师团队带着工具和材料开始承担人行桥维修工作。
